properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 31 at 1:06AM MST until October 31 at 3:15AM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Maricopa County in south central Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 315 AM MST.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of Indian Bend Wash is imminent or occurring.
Low-water crossings are inundated with water and may not be
passable. It will take several hours for all the water from these
storms to work through local drainage systems in urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 106 AM MST, streamflow gauge reports along Indian Bend Wash
indicated water levels were above alarm stage due to runoff from
earlier heavy rain. Flooding is already occurring in the warned
area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain have fallen.
- Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Paradise Valley and Scottsdale along Indian Bend Wash.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 30 at 9:02PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.

.Persistent northeast winds and downstream tidal effects on the St
John River are slowing flow at Astor.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 3.5 feet, Canals have overflowed into yards. Homes on
or near Wildhog, Bonnet and Snail roads become inaccessible with
several inches of water inside homes along the river and canals.
Docks at Astor Bridge marina and throughout Astor are completely
submerged. Bartram Rd and Holiday Circle are inaccessible with
yards completely submerged. Clair Street is inaccessible. Roads
flooded in South Moon Fish Camp, docks and yards at condominiums on
Juno Trail and water breaches the sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Friday the stage was 3.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 PM EDT Friday was 3.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood
stage at 3.6 feet.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Saturday afternoon at noon EDT.

properties.description:

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...San Francisco River at Reserve.

* WHEN...Rises on the river are expected to begin Sunday night and
last through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, Bankfull stage. Some minor overbank flow
may begin into drainage ditches near Highway 12.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:55 AM MDT Friday the stage was 10.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 13.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 13.0 feet
Monday morning.
- Action stage is 13.0 feet.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
